messages:
Rae: Tiny ask-the-room: pick one completely useless skill you'd memorize forever. One-liners only. :sparkles:
Tom: Speed-tying shoelaces. Olympic-level knots, instant fashion. :athletic_shoe:
Lin: Knowing the lyrics to every 90s one-hit wonder. Problem? Never. :musical_note:
Jules: Whispering to houseplants so they think I'm supportive. 24/7 encouragement. :seedling:
Oscar: Being able to fold any map back perfectly on first try. Ancient power. :world_map:
meme-bot: Poll created  react with 1 = shoelace, 2 = lyrics, 3 = plant-whisper, 4 = map-folding
Rae: Bonus: what's the activation phrase? Mine for map-folding: "Origami, obey."
Tom: Activation phrase for shoelaces: "Double-Double, no trip." :grin:
Lin: Lyrics activation is a dramatic throat-clear. I will perform. :microphone:
Jules: Plant whisper activation: a quiet "grow on, friend". :herb:
Oscar: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/vintage-map-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40 "map perfection"
Rae: Also rank them by how likely you'd use them outside of Slack. One emoji each.
Tom: :one: 100% useful on commute.
Lin: :two: salon karaoke nights = undefeated.
Jules: :three: therapy for ficus. :blossom:
Oscar: :four: impress grandparents.
Rae: Poll ends at lunchtime. Loser has to demonstrate their skill on camera next team social (consensually). :camera_with_flash:
Tom: I'm ready to demonstrate if necessary. Shoes at the ready. :athletic_shoe:
Lin: I will bring a playlist and a spotlight. :spotlight:
Jules: If plant-whisper loses I will still whisper to the ficus in the kitchen. It's used to it.
Oscar: If map-folding loses I'll start a secret society: "The Creased." :scroll:
Rae: Thanks for indulging my nonsense. Results when poll closes. :tada:
